modernizationPolicy.gateScope: All active slices complete Gate 1 through Gate 7 against this frozen legacy source.
modernizationPolicy.postFreezeChanges: Record source changes as DELTA entries without rewriting completed Gate evidence.
modernizationPolicy.integrationWave: Apply accumulated DELTA entries once after the frozen-scope Gate 1 through Gate 7 wave.
modernizationPolicy.affectedSliceRule: Re-run Gate 1 and the affected Gate 4 through Gate 7 evidence only for slices touched by a DELTA.
modernizationPolicy.unaffectedSliceRule: Carry forward verified Gate evidence when source, DB contract, fixture, provider dependency and output contract are unchanged.
modernizationPolicy.migrationRule: Never edit an applied migration; append a new migration for a DELTA.
modernizationPolicy.versionRule: Increase HoiBotVersion and add a developer-note entry only after the integration wave passes.
modernizationPolicy.rollbackRule: Restore by the frozen Git commit, schema migration boundary and recorded data checksums.

requirements: Verify final JSON and database checksums.
Run affected-slice parity and Shadow again.
Run the approved full integration smoke.
